title: I edit my reels from my phone with a Hermes bot
hook: I edit my reels from my phone with a Hermes bot

body: Metricool: scheduled Sat 24 Oct 13:00 IG + TikTok
guide: This sets up a chat bot on your phone that edits your short videos for you: you send a clip and an instruction, and it sends back the finished reel. You need a Telegram account, a computer that stays on, an open-source agent framework (such as Hermes Agent) or Claude Code, ffmpeg, and a Google Drive account.
1. Create a bot in Telegram by messaging BotFather, and keep the token it gives you somewhere private.
1. Install an open-source agent framework or Claude Code on the computer that stays on, and connect it to your Telegram bot so messages from your phone reach it.
1. Restrict the bot to your own Telegram user so nobody else can send it commands.
1. Install ffmpeg and give the agent permission to run it for the cuts, captions, resizing to 9:16 and audio clean-up you usually do by hand.
1. Put your raw clips in a Google Drive folder, and have the agent read from it and save finished reels to a second folder.
1. Send the bot a message such as "cut the dead air and add captions to the newest clip", and have it reply with a preview video.
1. Reply with changes in plain English until you are happy, then open the file in CapCut for any last touches.
1. Post it from Metricool, or have the agent schedule it there once you approve the preview.
Watch out: keep a human approval step before anything is published, and never paste your bot token into a chat or a public repository.

```
You are helping me build a personal video-editing bot that I control from my phone. Build it with <agent framework, e.g. Hermes Agent or Claude Code> on <Windows/Mac/Linux>.
What it must do:
- Receive messages from my Telegram bot, but only from my own user ID <my Telegram user ID>.
- When I send a video or name a clip in my Google Drive folder <input folder>, edit it with ffmpeg: <my edits, e.g. trim silences, add captions, crop to 9:16, normalise audio>.
- Save the result to my Google Drive folder <output folder> and send me a preview in Telegram.
- Accept follow-up instructions in plain English and re-render.
- Never publish anything. Only schedule a post in Metricool if I explicitly approve it.
Constraints:
- Keep the bot token and API keys in environment variables, never in code.
- Keep every earlier version of a render.
- Show me an error message in Telegram if a step fails.
Return: the folder structure, the full code, step-by-step setup instructions for a beginner, and a short test I can run to confirm it works.
```
